items.item_text: Graduation from high school or a General Education Diploma and two years of laboratory experience or two years of college including courses in the natural, physical or social sciences and one year of laboratory experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience

As a Lab Assistant II in the Department of Head and Neck Surgery, you will work closely with the Principal Investigator to support innovative research through laboratory experiments and procedures. You'll assist with specimen preparation, tissue processing, and microscopy analyses, while helping maintain laboratory supplies, safety records, and research documentation. This hands-on role also includes organizing experimental data and providing essential laboratory support that advances scientific discovery.
Perform multiple tasks simultaneously and prioritize responsibilities
Ability to work independently and as part of a team
Skill to maintain accurate scientific records
